originality.rationale: The geometric curve family, Klein-four automorphisms, splitting and superspecial possibility are inherited from published work and are explicitly excluded from novelty. The proposed new statement is the complete nonsuperspecial rank-one parameter set and scheme-theoretic length-nine determinantal locus with a triple embedded local point. Inspected same-family primary texts concern moduli equations and superspecial-only enumeration rather than this complete p-rank scheme. Historic priority uncertain and explicitly a residual risk.
residual_risks: An arithmetic table or detailed elliptic-quotient Hasse computation, possibly under different coordinates, may contain an equivalent rank-one classification without being retrieved.
The Ohashi full paper was not inspected beyond available abstract/metadata, although its maximality theorem appears restricted to superspecial objects.
The seven coefficient pairs need not represent seven distinct geometric isomorphism classes; no such claim is made.
